title: berlandiera texana var. betonicifolia
intro: Berlandiera texana var. betonicifolia, commonly known as Texas Beebalm, is a plant species in the Lamiaceae family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its ability to help manage blood sugar levels, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, that may contribute to its anti-diabetic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. Additionally, Texas Beebalm has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various ailments, including fever, sore throats, and digestive issues.
